comparison: Both controls start at the identical free-joint positions, quaternions and held robot commands. table_disabled changes only the support plane collision masks to zero. Unexpected control support successes, errors and incomplete runs remain in the denominator.
contact_recording_scope: Loaded shoe contacts are sampled every 20 ms. Expected outcomes require no non-table shoe contacts in any recorded sample; transients between samples are not ruled out.
independence_note: Matched seeded layouts are reused across robots and controls; these are synthetic numerical checks, not independent real shoes or held-out hardware trials.
scope: Native CPU scene loading, free rigid-shoe gravity and passive table support. Original procedural shoe proxies with assumed physical properties. No shoe grasping, organizing policy, deformation calibration, learned skill or hardware qualification.
timing_scope: Native-step timings measure mj_step only on this host; state extraction, mj_forward, compilation, rendering, sensing, training and actuation are excluded. Attempt wall includes verification, compilation, physics and state extraction. Run wall ends before report serialization. Process peak RSS includes prior allocations and is not a minimum memory requirement. These measurements do not establish real-time robot performance.
